features.apple: Find My app with People, Devices, Items and Me tabs
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/locate-desktop/src/window.rs:94 (LocateWindow::draw: sidebar of People, Devices, Items, Me; the content of each section); springboard/apps/locate-desktop/src/main.rs:26 (configure); springboard/apps/locate-desktop/manifest.toml (is.olibuijr.locate.desktop, window = full-size)
features.note: Locate is a full-size window with the four sections and a device list. There is no map pane yet, and nothing feeds the device list from the cloud, so it shows the empty state.
features.wire: Add the map pane with device pins using bifrost-maps (springboard/apps/maps-desktop) in window.rs draw. Load the device list with a background thread that calls cloud_findmy::devices_request and parse_devices (springboard/sdk/src/cloud_findmy.rs:78, :84) against GET {base}/findmy/devices, then Panel::apply_list. Route not built yet: bifrost-cloud feat/findmy-devices.

features.apple: List of the account's devices with last known location on a map and battery state
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/locate-desktop/src/panel.rs:120 (Panel::rows, this device first); springboard/apps/locate-desktop/src/panel.rs:104 (apply_list); springboard/apps/locate-desktop/src/window.rs:116 (body, Devices lines and empty state)
features.note: The Devices section lists the devices the cloud returned, this machine first, with battery and whether a position is known. No map and no live fetch: the list is empty until the cloud client runs.
features.wire: Poll GET {base}/findmy/devices every 60 s from a background thread and feed Panel::apply_list (cloud_findmy::devices_request, parse_devices). Route built in bifrost-cloud feat/findmy-devices (no position in the answer yet). Location is end to end encrypted (decided by the owner): the device seals {lat, lon, accuracy, timestamp, battery} with HPKE base mode to the account's Find My public key (bifrost_ui::hpke::seal_base, device id as info) and uploads one opaque location_sealed blob (migration 0006, not written yet); the cloud keeps only the public key (PUT /api/cloud/v1/findmy/keys, GET /findmy/keys/{account}). See docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Locate'.

features.feature: Play a sound on a device
features.apple: Play Sound (PlaySoundIntent) to find a nearby device
features.note: The control method queues play_sound for a device id, and the SDK builds the cloud command request. There is no Play Sound button in a window, and nothing is sent yet.
features.wire: Add a Play Sound button on the device card in window.rs, pressed by the person (no automatic sound). Send the queued request with command_request to POST {base}/findmy/devices/{id}/commands. The device polls GET {base}/findmy/devices/self/commands for pending commands (route not built: bifrost-cloud feat/findmy-devices).

features.apple: Mark as lost with a contact message and lock
features.note: Lost mode keeps the message and contact number and queues a lock, tested headless in springboard/apps/locate-desktop/tests/parity_app-find-my.rs. Gap: the lock screen does not show the message yet and nothing is delivered to a device.
features.wire: Send kind lost_mode with message and phone through POST {base}/findmy/devices/{id}/commands (the device_commands table in bifrost-cloud migration 0003 already holds the kind). The shell lock screen shows the message and phone number when the flag is set.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/cloud_findmy.rs:141 (command_request refuses erase unless confirmed); springboard/apps/locate-desktop/src/devices.rs (Device::request, CommandError::NeedsConfirmation)
features.note: The SDK refuses an erase command that is not confirmed, and the device model queues erase only after confirmation. No confirmation sheet and no cloud delivery yet.
features.wire: Confirmation sheet in the Devices section, then POST {base}/findmy/devices/{id}/commands with kind erase and confirmed true. The shell runs the installer's factory reset path when the device polls the command.

features.apple: Directions button opens the maps app
features.note: The driving directions link uses the maps app's link format, tested headless in springboard/apps/locate-desktop/tests/parity_app-find-my.rs. Gap: no button opens it yet.
features.wire: Open the Maps app with a route request (the maps: URL scheme from the Maps inventory) to the device position.

features.apple: Notify When Found and Notify When Left Behind
features.note: No notification pipeline from the cloud.
features.wire: Long poll GET {base}/findmy/events?after=N&wait=25 is built in bifrost-cloud. The app's background thread must post a shell notification for command_done and share_received events (not built).

features.apple: Share location with contacts for an hour, a day or indefinitely (ToggleLocationSharingIntent)
features.note: The Share My Location switch is a state with a control method. It does not grant sharing to any contact yet, and the switch on the Me page cannot be clicked.
features.wire: Share grants are built in bifrost-cloud: POST {base}/findmy/shares (contact's email, until or null) and DELETE /findmy/shares/{id}. Sealed copies: while a grant is active the owner's device also seals each report to the contact's account public key; revoking stops new copies and deletes stored ones (not built). Still to do: a Share My Location sheet that picks contacts, and the clickable switch.

features.apple: Friends on a map with distance, and notifications when someone arrives or leaves
features.note: Friend distances and arrival or departure rules are tested headless in springboard/apps/locate-desktop/tests/parity_app-find-my.rs. Gap: no friend positions come from the cloud and no notification is posted.
features.wire: Return granted friends' latest positions from the cloud API and draw them as pins with name and distance; add Notify Me rules (arrives, leaves) per friend.

features.apple: Tags and accessories on the finding network with separation alerts
features.note: Needs the vendor's crowd-sourced finding network and tag hardware, which BifrOSt has no equivalent of.

features.apple: Locate a device that is off or offline through nearby devices
features.note: Depends on the vendor's finding network.

features.apple: Device stays tied to the account after an erase
features.note: Hardware and boot-chain feature; the installer has no such attestation.

features.feature: Me tab: this device and location settings
features.apple: Share My Location switch, device name, location services state (NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription)
features.note: The Me page shows the sharing state and the location state. Location reads 'Location services unavailable' because the SDK has no location authorization service to read. The switch cannot be clicked yet, and this device's name is not read from the BifrOSt Account.
features.wire: Make the Share My Location switch clickable (hit test in window.rs; the switch is not drawn yet). Location reporting is off until the person turns it on here; turning it off or clearing deletes this device's cloud rows (DELETE sealed location, not built). Read this device's name from the cloud (GET /findmy/devices, this_device). When the SDK gains a location service, set Panel.location_status from its authorization state.

features.note: No consent flow in an app that does not exist.
features.wire: Ask for the contacts permission with the shell's permission prompt when the person opens Share My Location.

features.note: The three control methods are served and their parameters are parsed and tested. They are not yet intents for Search or Shortcuts.
